art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper

Preserve his high-collared dark uniform, long coat panels, gloves, opaque trousers, and boots. A recognizable moonstone firearm is carried pointed downward beside his leg, while additional weapon forms remain secured and inactive on his equipment harness.
art_direction.scene: An expansive horizontal arrangement inside the square for the complete character silhouette, concentrated facial drawing and loose peripheral marks. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: midnight blue, silver, pale moon cream, violet; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
